title: FLT-403: Route Replay: scrubber jumps when a trace has GPS gaps
summary: Priya Raman created FLT-403 in team Fleet. Status: Backlog. Priority: Medium. Labels: Bug, Route Replay. Project: Route Replay.
textSnippet:
Found while testing against the Kestrel demo dataset. When a trace has more than ~30s without a fix, the scrubber snaps to the next fix instead of interpolating, so the marker teleports.

Repro: load trace k-2291, scrub across 10:14–10:16.
Expected: marker moves smoothly along the last known heading.
condition: a new issue is filed about a bug one of our customers reported
rationale: Right connector, right event type, a genuine bug, and a customer's name in the body. Met loses because the bug was found by an engineer testing internally against a demo dataset; nothing says a customer reported it. The customer name attaches to the data, not to a report.
